Frames.sceneHelp: Ella decodes the full video and selects the frames with the largest visual changes. The frames are more representative, but the processing time is longer.
Frames.fixedHelp: Ella extracts frames at equal intervals and does not decode the full video. This method is faster, but the frames can be less representative.

Frames.help: These settings control the frame selection, count, and size for single and batch Smartag tasks. A batch task uses the settings from the time it starts.
Frames.autoHelp: Automatic selection uses 2 frames up to 30 seconds, 4 up to 5 minutes, 6 up to 30 minutes, and 8 for longer videos. More frames increase the inference time.

Frames.estimateHelp: The estimate does not include the inference time. Scene detection estimates change with the video encoding and the storage speed.
Frames.tagLanguageHelp: Automatic uses the title language first, then the interface language, then English. A language that you select has priority. Existing tags do not change.

BaiduSetup.storageFixWhere: Do these steps on the server that runs Ella, not in this browser. The paths below are examples. Replace them with your video folder and mount point. If a different person installed Ella, send these steps to that person.
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerFile: Open the deployment folder. Edit compose.yml (the name can also be docker-compose.yml). Find the app service and its volumes entry for /videos.
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerMount: Do not change the two folder paths. Change only the last mount option:
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerApply: Save the file. Then run this command in the folder that contains the Compose file. If the service has a different name, replace app with that name. This command creates the app container again, and access stops for a short time. A restart alone does not apply mount changes.
BaiduSetup.storageFixHost: Direct Linux installation, or Docker still shows read-only
BaiduSetup.storageFixHostFind: Examine the host mount that contains the video folder. TARGET is the mount point. ro in OPTIONS means read-only.
BaiduSetup.storageFixHostMount: If the mount configuration sets read-only, change ro to rw in the mount settings (usually /etc/fstab). In the command below, use the TARGET from the previous command, not the video subfolder. If the remount fails, do not force it. Ask the storage administrator to examine the file system.
BaiduSetup.storageFixNas: For a NAS or SMB share, also open the shared folder permissions on the NAS. Give read and write access to the account that mounts the share. A Docker rw setting cannot change a read-only host mount or NAS account.
BaiduSetup.storageFixOther: If the message shows a permission problem or a missing directory
BaiduSetup.storageFixPermissions: For a permission error, give the Ella service user write and directory traversal access. Use the folder permissions or the ACL. The official container uses UID 1001. A permission change alone cannot repair a read-only mount.
BaiduSetup.storageFixMissing: For a missing directory, connect or mount the storage first. Examine the host folder in the Compose file, or VIDEO_ROOT for a direct installation. Do not create an empty folder in place of a disconnected media mount.
BaiduSetup.storageFixRecheck: Come back to this page and select "Check again". When "Video library access" shows "Ready", continue.

BaiduSetup.storageReadOnly: The video directory is read-only. Playback works, but Ella cannot save downloads to it. To download videos, enable write access on the storage mount.
BaiduSetup.storagePermission: Ella does not have permission to write to the video directory. To save downloads, give the app user write access.
BaiduSetup.storageMissing: The video directory does not exist, or its parent path is not correct. Make sure that the storage is mounted and that the directory is correct.
BaiduSetup.storageUnavailable: Ella cannot confirm that it can save downloads. Examine the storage connection and the free space. Then try again.
BaiduSetup.description: Prepare the downloader and connect your Baidu account. Then start the downloads. Ella saves your settings automatically.
BaiduSetup.mediaHelp: The official Docker image contains all video tools. FFmpeg or FFprobe is missing on this server. Use the official image, or ask the server administrator to install the tools.
BaiduSetup.platformHelp: Automatic installation supports Linux amd64 and arm64. On other hosts, use the official Docker image.
BaiduSetup.openBaidu: Open Baidu Netdisk and sign in
BaiduSetup.cookieInstructions: In a desktop browser, open Developer Tools → Network. Refresh Baidu Netdisk. Select a request to pan.baidu.com. Copy the Cookie value under Request Headers.
BaiduSetup.pasteInstructions: Paste the value below. Ella examines the account and saves the connection on this server.
BaiduSetup.cookieHelp: The value must contain BDUSS and STOKEN. Keep it secret, as you keep a password. After you save it, Ella does not send it to the browser again.
BaiduSetup.finishHelp: Check the connection again. Then start the downloads. Ella saves the transferred files in your Baidu account. You can remove these copies later.
